source_access: Read-only official Godot4.6 documentation and exact4.6.3-stable engine source via web open. No local compiler or engine process.

observations: rtos_fix normalizes signed zero and NaNs, and avoids unnecessary double digits for float32 representations. This is ConfigFile serialization semantics, not IEEE bit identity.
Float writer preserves float literal type; StringName, NodePath and math types have native syntax.
Typed Dictionary/Array metadata is written explicitly; custom-script type references can fail encoding.
Objects may serialize properties/resource paths; recursion overflow emits an error and substitutes null. Text equality alone is not arbitrary Object identity proof.
Section/key enumeration returns complete current membership. Nil removes a key.
encode_to_text delegates values to VariantWriter but its section header differs from save escaping of closing brackets.
save opens the destination for writing; internal serialization returns OK. A fresh independent load and semantic comparison is needed for readback evidence.
load/parse progressively populate the ConfigFile rather than clearing earlier fields. Use a new ConfigFile for readback.
Malformed parsing returns its Error and logs a native parser diagnostic. No overwrite should follow a failed existing-file load.
Documented ConfigFile API stores Variants, exposes section/key sets, and returns Error for load/save. Mutation of the ConfigFile object alone is not a filesystem write.

review_implications: Compare exact section/key membership and types plus native ConfigFile value-serialization meaning. Do not substitute JSON or require undocumented full IEEE preservation.
Do not depend on whole-config textual key order or raw headers to compare documents. Fixed safe section/key wrappers can compare supported values without original header escaping differences.
Unsupported custom Object/scripted typed-container or cyclic/deep serialization must be refused before overwriting original data; no placeholder-based false pass.
After successful save but failed readback, memory restoration is separate from disk status. Do not claim disk rollback, power-loss durability, transactional/crash safety or cloud/server upload.
Malformed ConfigFile negative tests may emit expected native parser ERROR; this does not authorize overlooking SCRIPT ERROR or uncontrolled extra native diagnostics.
citation_scope: Primary-source API evidence only. No candidate GDScript parse or native testcase pass is implied.
